entries.author: JOANNES CANTACUZENUS IMP. CP.
entries.title: Historiae Byzantinae libri IV (de rebus sua aetate gestis, inde a morte Michaelis Palaeologi anno 1320 exstincti usque ad annum circiter 1354). Praemittuntur binae epistolae sub fictis Nili et Christoduli nominibus
entries.note: Body head HISTORIARUM LIBRI IV at line 1481, after page header '17 PROLEGOMENA 18'. The volume carries Libri I-III only: Ordo lists Liber I, II (407), III (703) and ends in Liber III (Cap. C near col 1283); no Liber IV head found in the OCR (Elenchus says IV). Parts are from the Ordo, columns as read: Liber primus '4' (garbled; body head LIBER PRIMUS at line 5880, col ~55, Nilus-Christodulus letters at line 3206, col ~31), Nilus Christodulo 'ål' (garbled).

problems: Elenchus lists a single item; the cut (lines 993-1238) runs on into the Notitia, which the Elenchus does not list. Not entered: Notitia (Ordo 9, Fabricius), Prolegomena (Ordo; body 'PROLEGOMENA' from col 13, Pontanus et al.), Argumenta librorum.
Elenchus says libri IV; the OCR/Ordo show only Libri I-III in this volume (cols 17-1320), Liber IV apparently in the next tome; not resolved.
The OCR has junk/gibberish page text near the end (lines ~98263-98557) and in the front (lines 245-600), so front columns 1-12 are unmapped.
